name: HC Quickie
description: I've seen a lot of requests for 4 player compatible decks for Brethren of Ash (i.e. requiring one core set) - this is my take on it. I'll keep these guides briefer than normal!

decks.name: Daniela Reyes: 4 Player Compatible
decks.introMd: You have ample strong weapons to fight enemies with, likely saving any [Winchester Model 12](/card/12029) you find for the big bad guy. Clues are [Lesson Learned](/card/12022), ["Look what I found!"](/card/12078) and [Scene of the Crime](/card/12024), with these events being recurable with [Hunter's Instinct](/card/12074).

decks.name: Trish Scarborough: 4 Player Compatible
decks.introMd: Draw cards with [Lucky Cigarette Case](/card/12044), move around with [Olivier Bishop](/card/12046), find clues with [Magnifying Glasses](/card/12034) plus [Dorothy Simmons](/card/12030), and occasionally shoot things with [M1903 Hammerless](/card/12045).

decks.name: Dexter Drake: 4 Player Compatible
decks.introMd: With [Jim Culver](/card/12060) you can clue-find at a 6 with [Second Sight](/card/12062) or fight at an 8 with upgraded [Cosmic Flame](/card/12071). [Lucky Charm](/card/12061) allows you to move horror off other investigators, which [Fearless](/card/12069) can then heal.

decks.name: Izzie Barnes: 4 Player Compatible
decks.introMd: [Meat Cleaver](/card/12077) with [Aleksey Saburov](/card/12072) and [Cloak of Resonance](/card/12058) allow you to deal good damage (putting the horror on your soak assets) and heal horror off yourself from Izzie's ability.
